name: Install Ollama in Docker
description: Install Ollama server in Docker on target server using official ollama/ollama image

steps.title: Pull and run Ollama Docker container
steps.prompt: Execute via server_execute on server lunix: 1) docker pull ollama/ollama 2) docker run -d --name ollama -v ollama:/root/.ollama -p 11434:11434 --restart unless-stopped ollama/ollama. Verify container is running with docker ps. Output <promise>STEP_DONE</promise> when done
